bends.reason: B1 (seq 1, 364007) joins the steep web to the short strip that carries the motor-frame. STATE_CHECK case, judged from the global views (no section images). Raw SIDE: the B1-B2 strip is a thin edge-on bar parallel to the edge-on arm, and the web between them is a steep band, so web and strip are in different planes. Raw FRONT: the web climbs steeply from the arm and the strip lies nearly level along the top. Both match the recipe CAD with every bend formed. Direction note: B1 turns opposite to B3 (B3+B1 form a joggle that brings the strip back parallel to the arm) and the same way as B2. The scan shows it folded to the CAD side. The registered overlay (confidence OK) covers the CAD at B1 with no stray points.

B2 (seq 2, 34f314) joins the strip to the square frame with the large round hole. Raw FRONT: the frame is face-on and hangs steeply down from the strip at the top. Raw SIDE: the frame ring rises steeply from the edge-on strip. Raw TOP: beyond B2 the frame is a foreshortened parallelogram with an elliptical hole. So the frame is clearly not in the strip's plane, matching the CAD (fold roughly 80-90 deg). It turns the same way as B1 (opposite to B3) and is folded to the CAD side: a frame folded the other way would rise instead of hang and fall outside the CAD silhouette, and it does not.

B3 (seq 3, 24d28f) joins the long holed arm to the web along the arm's side edge. Raw SIDE: the arm is a thin edge-on bar and the web leaves it as a wide steep band, not a continuation of the bar. Raw FRONT: the web rises steeply from the arm's end. Raw TOP: the B3-B1 band shows dense, foreshortened points, as expected for a steep surface. All match the CAD. Direction note: B3 is the reverse-direction bend relative to B1/B2 (joggle partner of B1); the scan follows the CAD direction. Whole-part check on the registered overlay (confidence OK), all four views: 0-1 CAD silhouette px lack a scan point within 5 px, and 0 scan px lie outside the CAD. Shifting the scan by 8 px already gives 2-8% mismatch, so an unformed flange would show up.
